notes: One file for Steering Package prices and contents. Manufacturer packs are $3.99. Edit priceCents on a package to change it. A class pack stays unsellable while priceStatus is TODO. templates are the wheel ids a purchase unlocks. includedFree lists wheels that stay free without a purchase. Drop new template ids in here, then run node worker/scripts/hash-packs.mjs.
